| Category = Meat recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
*Ripe [[Cookbook:Plantain|plantains]] (gonja)
*[[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]] or [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]
*Smoked [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausages]] (farmers choice smokies)
*Vegetable confetti (chopped [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell peppers]], etc. As many colours as you can get)
*[[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
*[[Cookbook:Vinegar|Vinegar]]
*[[Cookbook:Black Pepper|Black pepper]]

==Procedure==
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 175°C.
#Peel the plantains and smear them with butter. Place on oven tray. 
#Place sausages on oven rack.
#Put tray and rack in oven. 
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 170°C for 30–35 minutes.
#[[Cookbook:Chopping|Chop]] the vegetables, and douse with olive oil and vinegar.
#Serve and sprinkle with black pepper if you so wish.
